Un grand merci à Lily et Robert pour leurs conseils et leurs sourires au quotidien. 장윤진 5 August 2025 Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. 위치 좋고 에어컨 잘되고 직원분들이 하나같이 다 친절하셨어요❤️ 룸 상태 깔끔하고 침대 엄청 푹신ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 잘잤어요 넘 피곤해서 조식은 못먹었지만 주변에 맛집많고 호수랑도 가깝고 다음에 다시 간다면 또 가고싶어용!! あっこ 2 August 2025 Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. 娘、孫と三世代で利用させていただきました。 立地も良く、水回りは綺麗で（TOTO製）、小さいホテルですがスタッフさんは皆親切です。4日間の滞在中、孫はスタッフさんとすっかり親しくなり、優しくしていただいたお礼に翻訳アプリで手紙を書いて、持参した折り紙で折り鶴を作って渡したら、皆さんとても喜んでくれました。日本に来たこともあるスタッフさんもいて、日本観光の写真を見せてくれました。ホッと出来る瞬間でした。リピ確定です。 Catherine Siok Kiang 31 July 2025 Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. This is the hotel that have real room that better than in photos. I found this hotel while walking around during my stay in old quarter, i walk in hotel, the lobby smell nice. So i search online to check the room type and asking which room have balcony. Coz i only stay in balcony room while in old quarters 😊. Turn out it was a good 2 nights stay experience. Room: the room type i stay is Signature Room with balcony (Room#602), which is spacious. With bathtub and is clean and usable. Corridor and public area was kept clean. Breakfast was served on ground floor next to reception, buffet breakfast with good spread choices and live egg station and soup noodles can be ordered from. Got enough staff to serve, clear and clean table. Thanks, much appreciate that guest can eat in clean environment. Had brief chat with Manager Ms TraLee who always in lobby during breakfast time, guests check-in & check out time. Thanks the owner and manager for make sure the comfort and cleanliness of the guest during their stay by keeping the hotel property well-maintained and clean. Please keep up the good work. And this is considered new hotel, opened December 2023. I recommend this hotel and will definitely choose this hotel again on my return visit to Hanoi Old Quarter. Trip.com Member 24 July 2025 Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Perfect place with a perfect location. Room was comfortable and very clean. Everything is within walking distance. Will stay here again. Staff also super friendly and helpful!
